    if re.search(r"ü|<|>", input_text):
        return "Access Denied"
    elif input_text == "Aa123aA":
        return "Access Granted"
    else:
        return "Access Denied"

while True:
    user_input = input("> ")
    if re.search(r"ü|<|>", user_input):
        print("Access Denied")
    else:
        print(access_denied(user_input))
